name: Griefing Rules
summary: Stop creepers, ghasts, the wither, endermen or ravagers from changing your blocks, one gamerule each, while villagers keep farming.
logoPrompt: A single cracked stone brick block standing on a small grass block, wrapped in a glowing green protective shield bubble, blocky voxel style, no text

cover.tagline: One gamerule per kind of mob griefing.

description: **Griefing Rules splits the mobGriefing gamerule, so you can stop creeper craters without stopping your villagers from farming.**
- `creeperGriefing` and `ghastGriefing`: explosions still hurt players and mobs but break no blocks; ghast fireballs light no fire.
- `witherGriefing`: the wither's blasts and skulls break nothing, it cannot break out when hurt, and its wither roses drop as items.
- `endermanGriefing`: endermen no longer pick up or place blocks.

Put the jar into the `mods` folder next to Fabric API. Every rule starts on; switch one off in chat or the server console, for example `/gamerule creeperGriefing false`. The others: `/gamerule ghastGriefing false`, `/gamerule witherGriefing false`, `/gamerule endermanGriefing false`, `/gamerule ravagerGriefing false`.
- Made for Fabric on Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21.1 and needs Fabric API.
- On a server only the server needs it; players join without installing anything.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
